ModMetaData.name: ProjectZ GameRange test Defs
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description: Test patches for ProjectZ mode gamerange (another mod changing vanilla ranges). A template: it ships inside ProjectZ's Source/Dev but is never loaded from there (RimWorld loads only mods directly in its Mods folder). For a test run: Source/Dev/testmods.sh install gamerange, then remove gamerange.
